checks.name: Project Isolation
checks.expected: Clone isolation intact and source read-only
checks.actual: Clone isolation verified. Original project is read-only and clean.

checks.name: Module Import
checks.expected: DirectionEngine and models importable from arbitrage

checks.name: Both Candidates Evaluated
checks.expected: evaluate_candidates returns Candidate A and Candidate B
checks.actual: Result type: DirectionEvaluationResult, candidate_a: True, candidate_b: True
checks.technical_basis: Step 6 requirement: Evaluate Candidate A and Candidate B.

checks.name: Required Candidate Fields
checks.expected: All 7 required fields present on both candidates: ['maker_venue', 'maker_price', 'hedge_venue', 'hedge_price', 'direction', 'timestamps', 'validity']
checks.technical_basis: Step 6 requirement: Maker venue, Maker price, Hedge venue, Hedge price, direction, timestamps, validity.

checks.name: Role Independence
checks.expected: Candidate A has A as Maker, B as Hedge; Candidate B has B as Maker, A as Hedge
checks.actual: A: Maker=BINANCE, Hedge=BYBIT | B: Maker=BYBIT, Hedge=BINANCE
checks.technical_basis: Never assume Reference = Hedge or Priced = Maker.

checks.name: Executable Price Integrity
checks.expected: Executable prices are strictly positive and match valid book levels
checks.actual: A prices: maker=60010.0, hedge=60200.0 | B prices: maker=60200.0, hedge=60010.0
checks.technical_basis: Actual executable bid/ask relationship must be preserved.

checks.name: Negative Test — Stale Data Rejection
checks.expected: Stale market data (>10s) must be marked validity=False
checks.technical_basis: Stale/invalid market data must produce no valid executable candidates.

checks.name: Zero Order Placement Invariant
checks.expected: No order placement method invocations in DirectionEngine
